# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_VIX_TREND_OOS_CONFIRMED

**Filed:** 2026-05-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new trade class
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The hypothesis is that the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trade class, when combined with a VIX trend filter (VIX >= 18 and VIX > 5d_avg), can produce a positive edge in the SPY 0DTE options market. The VIX trend filter is designed to capture escalating volatility regimes, which may be favorable for the SNIPER trade class.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves detecting SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trades and filtering them based on the VIX trend condition. The VIX trend filter uses a 5-day moving average of VIX to determine if the current VIX value is escalating. If the condition is met, the trade is executed; otherwise, it is skipped.
